# structure

> Effect-based TypeScript framework monorepo for agent-focused backend software. Bun workspaces; packages import as `@structure/<name>` via workspace references. Every package: `src/index.ts` is the public API, `README.md` documents it, `test/` shows working usage.

## Packages

- [@structure/config](packages/config/README.md): settings DSL (Settings.string/int/port/url/duration/secret/literal/optional/struct/nested), load() with precedence overrides→env→file→dotenv→defaults, all-errors-at-once ConfigLoadError, renderDocs() markdown settings table.
- [@structure/observability](packages/observability/README.md): layer() for structured JSON logging + OTLP export, ServiceMeta, Correlation.within/scoped for correlation ids on logs+spans, Metrics.boundary/track for traffic-errors-latency.
- [@structure/domain](packages/domain/README.md): EntityId.define branded ids, ValueObject.define schema values, Aggregate.define decider (initial/decide/evolve) + rehydrate/execute, DomainEvent.define, EventMetadata/Envelope, Repository port, errors InvariantViolation/NotFound/ConcurrencyConflict/ValidationFailed with FailureClass.
- [@structure/cqrs](packages/cqrs/README.md): Command.define/Query.define with Schema payload+success, CommandBus/QueryBus dispatch with validation, Authorizer hook, IdempotencyStore, timeouts, spans+metrics per dispatch.
- [@structure/eventsourcing](packages/eventsourcing/README.md): EventStore/SnapshotStore/CheckpointStore/Outbox/Inbox ports, EventRegistry codec with upcasters, AggregateStore (load/execute/executeWithRetry, optimistic concurrency), Projection catchup/run/rebuild, OutboxRelay with bounded retry + dead letters, in-memory layers for everything.
- [@structure/eventsourcing-sqlite](packages/eventsourcing-sqlite/README.md): the same ports over bun:sqlite with transactional append + outbox.
- [@structure/eventsourcing-pg](packages/eventsourcing-pg/README.md): the same ports over PostgreSQL via @effect/sql-pg.
- [@structure/migrations](packages/migrations/README.md): defineMigration/makeSet ordered forward-only SQL migrations on @effect/sql Migrator (dialect-agnostic, lock-protected), run/status/layer, migrationsCommand CLI group via subpath ./cli.
- [@structure/runtime](packages/runtime/README.md): Readiness service (flag + named checks), Shutdown coordinator (reverse-order bounded finalizers), AppRuntime.launch Bun entrypoint, config-invalid startup reporting.
- [@structure/http](packages/http/README.md): HttpApi route/handler definitions, OpenAPI JSON + Swagger UI, /health/live|ready probes, error→response mapping without leaking internals, CQRS endpoint bridge, Bun serve with graceful shutdown.
- [@structure/cli](packages/cli/README.md): defineCommand on @effect/cli, standard --log-level/--config-file flags, classified exit codes, runCli entrypoint.
- [@structure/ai](packages/ai/README.md): LanguageModel layers for Anthropic/OpenAI from settings, generateText/generateObject with usage metrics, transient-only bounded retries, TestModel.layer for deterministic tests.
- [@structure/mcp](packages/mcp/README.md): defineMcpServer with schema-typed tools/resources, CQRS command/query→tool bridge, stdio + HTTP transports.

## Conventions

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): commands, hard rules, dependency direction, VCS conventions.
- [README.md](README.md): human overview and design rules.
